name: r6-mut-daily-blob-text
description: Mutation triage (inventory pass, daily-0600 rows; blob-text on irrigation_schedules.last_triggered_at in r3-q3-daily-nul-valve and on irrigation_zones.scheduling_mode in 090): decision.js coerces the zone row's columns with String() and Number(), which read a Buffer's bytes as UTF-8 text. Zone 1's BLOB stamp of today debounces (no second open today), zone 2's BLOB threshold '20' and duration '15' count as numbers (open for 15 minutes), zone 3's BLOB 'server_preferred' takes the shared recommendation. Go read the Buffer-shaped value as '[object Object]' or NaN: it opened zone 1 again, used threshold NaN and duration 10 for zone 2, and took the local recommendation for zone 3. Zone 4 is the TEXT control.

steps.sql: INSERT INTO devices(deveui,name,type_id,user_id,irrigation_zone_id,current_state,created_at,updated_at) VALUES ('A8404100000000F1','Stamp valve','STREGA_VALVE',1,1,'CLOSED','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),('A8404100000000F2','Numbers valve','STREGA_VALVE',1,2,'CLOSED','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),('A8404100000000F3','Server valve','STREGA_VALVE',1,3,'CLOSED','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),('A8404100000000F4','Control valve','STREGA_VALVE',1,4,'CLOSED','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),('A8404100000000E1','Stamp probe','KIWI_SENSOR',1,1,NULL,'2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),('A8404100000000E2','Numbers probe','KIWI_SENSOR',1,2,NULL,'2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'),('A8404100000000E4','Control probe','KIWI_SENSOR',1,4,NULL,'2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z','2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');INSERT INTO device_data(deveui,recorded_at,swt_1,swt_2,swt_3) VALUES ('A8404100000000E1',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),100,100,100),('A8404100000000E2',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),100,100,100),('A8404100000000E4',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),100,100,100);INSERT INTO zone_daily_recommendations(zone_id,date,computed_at,irrigation_action,action_reasoning,zone_stress_summary) VALUES (3,'2020-01-01',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),'decrease_10','Local recommendation','moderate');INSERT INTO zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid,summary_json,last_received_at) SELECT zone_uuid,'{"water":{"action":{"code":"emergency_irrigate","source":"dendro","date":"2020-01-02","reasoning":"Shared recommendation"}},"drift":{"serverActionCode":true}}',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id=3;

steps.why: The stored values a hostile import could write as BLOBs; node-sqlite3 reads each as a Buffer. Zone 1's stamp is UTC midnight of the run day: the same bytes on every run of that day, and the same UTC-day window decision.js debounces on.
steps.sql: UPDATE irrigation_schedules SET last_triggered_at=CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00.000Z','now') AS BLOB) WHERE irrigation_zone_id=1;UPDATE irrigation_schedules SET threshold_kpa=CAST('20' AS BLOB), duration_minutes=CAST('15' AS BLOB) WHERE irrigation_zone_id=2;UPDATE irrigation_zones SET scheduling_mode=CAST('server_preferred' AS BLOB) WHERE id=3;
